sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN "ap_index_nT" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE AS n_ap_null, MIN("Timestamp") AS min_ts, MAX("Timestamp") AS max_ts FROM OMNI2 WHERE "Timestamp" >= TIMESTAMP '2024-05-01 00:00:00' AND "Timestamp" < TIMESTAMP '2024-05-31 00:00:00'

SELECT COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n_total, SUM(CASE WHEN "EPOCH" >= TIMESTAMP '2024-05-01 00:00:00' AND "EPOCH" < TIMESTAMP '2024-05-31 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE AS n_may_window, MIN("EPOCH") AS min_epoch, MAX("EPOCH") AS max_epoch FROM space_track WHERE "NORAD_CAT_ID" = 43180
SELECT COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n_rows, MIN("Timestamp") AS min_ts, MAX("Timestamp") AS max_ts FROM OMNI2
SELECT COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT "NORAD_CAT_ID")::DOUBLE AS n_ids, MIN("EPOCH") AS min_epoch, MAX("EPOCH") AS max_epoch FROM space_track

SELECT "NORAD_CAT_ID" AS norad_id, COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n_rows, MIN("EPOCH") AS min_epoch, MAX("EPOCH") AS max_epoch, MAX("OBJECT_NAME") AS obj_name FROM space_track GROUP BY "NORAD_CAT_ID" ORDER BY "NORAD_CAT_ID"
SELECT "YEAR" AS year, COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n_rows, MIN("Timestamp") AS min_ts, MAX("Timestamp") AS max_ts FROM OMNI2 GROUP BY "YEAR" ORDER BY "YEAR"

SELECT COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS hits, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CAST("NORAD_CAT_ID" AS VARCHAR)) AS norad_vals, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "OBJECT_ID") AS object_ids, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "source_file") AS source_files FROM space_track WHERE CAST("NORAD_CAT_ID" AS VARCHAR) = '43180' OR "OBJECT_ID" LIKE '%43180%' OR "TLE_LINE1" LIKE '%43180%' OR "TLE_LINE2" LIKE '%43180%' OR "OBJECT_NAME" LIKE '%43180%'
SELECT COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n_rows, MIN("Timestamp") AS min_ts, MAX("Timestamp") AS max_ts, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "source_file") AS sources FROM "Sat_Density"
SELECT * FROM "swarmb" LIMIT 5
SELECT * FROM "0309geomag_forecast" LIMIT 10
SELECT MIN("Timestamp") AS ts, MIN("Semi-major Axis (km)") AS sma, COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n_rows, MAX("Timestamp") AS max_ts FROM "wu001_to_wu715_initial_states"
SELECT "source_file", COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n_rows FROM "swarmb" GROUP BY "source_file" ORDER BY "source_file"
SELECT "FILE" AS file_val, COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n_rows FROM space_track GROUP BY "FILE" ORDER BY "FILE"

WITH numbered AS ( SELECT "############################################################################" AS line, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "source_file") AS rn FROM "swarmb" WHERE "source_file" LIKE '%2024_05%' ) SELECT line, rn AS n FROM numbered LIMIT 15

WITH numbered AS ( SELECT "############################################################################" AS line, ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS rn FROM "swarmb" WHERE "source_file" LIKE '%2024_05%' AND line LIKE '%TLE%' ) SELECT line, rn AS n FROM numbered LIMIT 20
SELECT "NORAD_CAT_ID" AS norad_id, "EPOCH" AS epoch, "MEAN_MOTION" AS mean_motion, "OBJECT_NAME" AS object_name, "source_file" AS source_file FROM space_track ORDER BY "NORAD_CAT_ID", "EPOCH"
SELECT COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n_rows, MIN("YEAR") AS min_year, MAX("YEAR") AS max_year, SUM(CASE WHEN "YEAR" = 2024 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE AS n_2024 FROM OMNI2
SELECT COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n_rows, MIN("Timestamp") AS min_ts, MAX("Timestamp") AS max_ts FROM goes_wu334_20160824_to_20161023
SELECT COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n_rows, MIN("Timestamp") AS min_ts, MAX("Timestamp") AS max_ts FROM "wu001_to_wu715_initial_states"

SELECT "NORAD_CAT_ID" AS norad_id, SUM(CASE WHEN "source_file" LIKE '%quiet%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE AS n_quiet, SUM(CASE WHEN "source_file" LIKE '%storm%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE AS n_storm, COUNT(DISTINCT "source_file")::DOUBLE AS n_per_file, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT ("NORAD_CAT_ID"::VARCHAR || '|' || CAST("EPOCH" AS VARCHAR))) AS n_epoch_dupes FROM space_track GROUP BY "NORAD_CAT_ID"
SELECT "EPOCH" AS epoch, "MEAN_MOTION" AS mean_motion, "source_file" AS source_file FROM space_track WHERE "NORAD_CAT_ID" = 58600 ORDER BY "EPOCH"
